name: agent-flow-channel
_overrides_note: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk pins @hono/node-server ^1, but every 1.x release carries GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9 and npm's suggested 'fix' is to downgrade the MCP SDK. We only use the SDK's stdio transport, so the hono-backed HTTP transports never load and the v1->v2 break is unreachable. Revisit if this server ever adopts StreamableHTTP.
